core_obligations: Apply the general theory (proof lines 3597-3630): the author sets up the abstract construction of the left derived functor of the pullback f^* using the class of complexee on which f^* computes the derived functor, and verifies that the hypotheses of the general result from the chapter Derived Categories hold in this situation.

Identify the values (proof lines 3630-3645): for a K-flat complex with flat terms the class contains the complex, so by the corresponding result of this chapter the derived pullback agrees with the naive pullback; the same holds in particular for bounded above complexes of flat modules.
Exactness and triangulatedness (proof lines 3645-3655): the abstract result also delivers the exactness and the triangulated character of Lf^*, which are the remaining clauses of the statement.
proof_roadmap: Invoke the general construction of a left derived functor with respect to a suitable class of complexes.
Check that the class is contained in the complexes on which the pullback computes the derived functor.
Use the behaviour of K-flat complexes with flat terms under pullback to identify the values.
Collect the exactness and triangulated properties delivered by the abstract result.
difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs the derived pullback Lf^* of a morphism of ringed topoi and identifies it with the naive pullback on K-flat complexes with flat terms and on bounded above complexes of flat modules (statement lines 3584-3595). The proof is a verification that the general theory of derived functors applies: the author sets up the construction through a class of complexes, checks the hypotheses of the abstract result of the chapter Derived Categories, and then uses the same-chapter stability of K-flat complexes with flat terms under pullback to identify the values (proof lines 3597-3655). The non-formal content is the choice of the class and the verification of the hypotheses in this geometric setting. The claim is H2: a construction by general theory whose verification is written out in a single long paragraph.
